annotations.description: Keeping a 6-card hand with 5 Mountains and 2 spells (Furious Rise and Heartfire) that both require creatures to function. This hand does literally nothing until creatures are drawn off the top, as Furious Rise needs a 4-power creature and Heartfire needs a sacrifice. The hand has zero board presence and no path to affecting the game without topdecking.
annotations.actionTaken: Kept a 6-card hand of 5 Mountains, Furious Rise, and Heartfire.
annotations.betterLine: Mulligan to 5 hoping for at least one creature. While going to 5 is painful, this 6-card hand is essentially a 0-spell hand since both spells are dead without creatures. A 5-card hand with even one creature would be significantly more functional.

annotations.description: Opponent's only creature (Crypt Lurker 3/4) has summoning sickness and cannot block. Opponent has zero untapped lands, so no combat tricks are possible. Spiteful Prankster would deal 3 uncontested damage, representing a significant portion of the opponent's life total.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to attack with Spiteful Prankster, dealing 0 damage.
annotations.betterLine: Attack with Spiteful Prankster for 3 free damage. There are no possible blockers and no mana available for any interaction.

annotations.description: Passed with 1 mana available and no other use for it, declining to equip Malefic Scythe (1 soul counter, giving +1/+1) to Bone Picker. This would have made Bone Picker a 4/3 flying deathtouch at no meaningful cost, ready to attack next turn as a stronger threat.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without equipping Malefic Scythe to Bone Picker.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Malefic Scythe's equip ability targeting Bone Picker, making it a 4/3 flying deathtouch for next turn's attack.

annotations.description: Cast Burst Lightning while Bone Picker (3/2 flying deathtouch) was on the stack, using their only untapped mana. This prevents them from using Burst Lightning to kill Bone Picker after it resolves (it has 2 toughness, exactly matching Burst Lightning's damage). A 3/2 flying deathtouch creature is a serious threat that Burst Lightning cleanly answers.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Burst Lightning in response to Bone Picker on the stack (likely targeting opponent's face for 2 damage)
annotations.betterLine: Let Bone Picker resolve, then cast Burst Lightning targeting Bone Picker to kill it. Removing a 3/2 flying deathtouch creature is far more valuable than 2 damage to the opponent's face.

annotations.description: Passed in postcombat main with 4 untapped Mountains and Furious Rise in hand castable for {2}{R}. While Furious Rise wouldn't trigger this end step (no 4+ power creature), deploying it now costs nothing meaningful and positions for future card advantage the moment a qualifying creature hits the board (e.g., Pitchburn Devils with any buff, or a future draw). Holding it gains nothing since there's no better use for the mana this turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority, wasting 4 mana and ending the turn without casting anything.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Furious Rise for {2}{R} to have it on board ready to generate card advantage as soon as a 4+ power creature is deployed.

annotations.description: Declined to cast Temur Battle Rage on Spiteful Prankster during combat when the opponent has no blockers and is completely tapped out. This wastes 3 free damage (6 instead of 3). The mana saved doesn't enable anything meaningful - Furious Rise can't trigger without a power 4+ creature, and Pitchburn Devils costs 5 mana. Temur Battle Rage is a combat trick that may not find a better window.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed on casting Temur Battle Rage, attacking for only 3 damage.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Temur Battle Rage on Spiteful Prankster for double strike, dealing 6 damage to the opponent instead of 3, with zero risk since opponent has no blockers and no mana available.

annotations.description: Declined to cast Temur Battle Rage on an unblocked Spiteful Prankster, missing 3 extra damage for free. The alternative use of mana (Furious Rise) wouldn't trigger since no creature with power 4+ is on board. Pitchburn Devils costs 5 mana and can't be cast anyway.

annotations.description: GPT54 Coach passed their precombat main phase with 5 untapped lands and castable spells in hand. Furious Rise costs {2}{R} and would be excellent here — Spiteful Prankster is only 3 power so it wouldn't trigger immediately, but once Pitchburn Devils (power 3) comes down next turn or any 4+ power creature appears, it starts generating card advantage. More importantly, Pitchburn Devils costs {4}{R} and could be cast with the 5 available Mountains (4 Mountains + the 5th land). Wait — checking: the battlefield shows 4 Mountains and the player has 0 land drops remaining, so they have exactly 5 mana. Pitchburn Devils costs {4}{R} = 5 mana total, so it IS castable this turn. Pitchburn Devils is a 3/3 that deals 3 damage when it dies, which is a strong threat. Casting it would put a creature with power 3 on board alongside Spiteful Prankster (power 3), but neither hits 4 power for Furious Rise. Still, Pitchburn Devils is a strong board presence that synergizes with Spiteful Prankster's death trigger. The player passed with a castable 3/3 creature that has a powerful death trigger, wasting 5 mana and a full turn's development. Even Furious Rise for 3 mana would have been a reasonable play to set up future card advantage.
